blocks.text:
Date: 12 September 2026
Attendees: Helen Marsh (Acme), Jonas Becker, Lena Vogt (Northwind)
On-time delivery was 94% in August, below the 97% target. Two late pallets of pipe fittings were caused by a carrier strike in Rotterdam.
Northwind asked for the 6% volume discount tier to start at 200 pallets per month. Acme will respond by 30 September.

| Owner | Action | Due |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Helen Marsh | Propose revised discount tiers | 2026-09-30 |
| Lena Vogt | Share Q4 volume forecast | 2026-09-25 |
| Jonas Becker | Review liability cap with legal | 2026-10-15 |
